body.title: WWF Terrestrial Ecoregions of the World (2017 update)
body.description: Global terrestrial ecoregions from the World Wildlife Fund (WWF), based on the landmark Olson et al. (2001) classification. The dataset delineates 847 ecoregions grouped into 14 biomes and 9 biogeographic realms. Each ecoregion represents a distinct community of plants and animals sharing evolutionary history. The 2017 revision incorporates the Nature Needs Half (NNH) index, which categorizes each ecoregion by its current level of nature protection and potential for recovery. Available as GeoParquet for analysis, PMTiles for web mapping, H3 hexagonal parquet (resolution 8) for spatial joins, and the original GDB source.

ecoregion-parquet.title: GeoParquet — 847 global terrestrial ecoregions
ecoregion-parquet.description: Cloud-native GeoParquet with polygon geometries in EPSG:4326. One row per ecoregion.

table:columns.name: _cng_fid
table:columns.description: Universal per-feature synthetic id assigned by cng-datasets on conversion (one per source row, row-unique). Use for dedup / COUNT(DISTINCT) and joins across assets.

table:columns.name: OBJECTID
table:columns.description: Original object identifier from the source geodatabase (per-feature key, not a class).

table:columns.name: ECO_NAME
table:columns.description: Full name of the ecoregion (e.g., 'Amazon River and Flooded Forests'). Unique per ecoregion.

table:columns.name: BIOME_NUM
table:columns.description: Biome numeric code (WWF 14-biome scheme). Values: 1=Tropical & Subtropical Moist Broadleaf Forests, 2=Tropical & Subtropical Dry Broadleaf Forests, 3=Tropical & Subtropical Coniferous Forests, 4=Temperate Broadleaf & Mixed Forests, 5=Temperate Conifer Forests, 6=Boreal Forests/Taiga, 7=Tropical & Subtropical Grasslands, Savannas & Shrublands, 8=Temperate Grasslands, Savannas & Shrublands, 9=Flooded Grasslands & Savannas, 10=Montane Grasslands & Shrublands, 11=Tundra, 12=Mediterranean Forests, Woodlands & Scrub, 13=Deserts & Xeric Shrublands, 14=Mangroves.

table:columns.name: BIOME_NAME
table:columns.description: Biome name. One of 14 terrestrial biome types (e.g., 'Tropical & Subtropical Moist Broadleaf Forests', 'Tundra', 'Deserts & Xeric Shrublands').

table:columns.name: REALM
table:columns.description: Biogeographic realm. One of: Afrotropic, Antarctica, Australasia, Indomalayan, Nearctic, Neotropic, Oceania, Palearctic.

table:columns.name: ECO_BIOME_
table:columns.description: Combined ecoregion–biome identifier string (concatenates realm / biome / ecoregion codes). High-cardinality identifier, not an enumeration.

table:columns.name: NNH
table:columns.description: Nature Needs Half index (numeric). Values: 0=N/A, 1=Half Protected, 2=Nature Could Reach Half Protected, 3=Nature Could Recover, 4=Nature Imperiled.

table:columns.name: NNH_NAME
table:columns.description: Nature Needs Half category label. Values: N/A=Not applicable, Half Protected=ecoregion is at least half protected, Nature Could Reach Half Protected=could reach half protected, Nature Could Recover=could recover, Nature Imperiled=nature imperiled.

table:columns.name: ECO_ID
table:columns.description: Unique numeric ecoregion identifier.

table:columns.name: SHAPE_LENG
table:columns.description: Perimeter length in original CRS units.

table:columns.name: COLOR
table:columns.description: Hex color string (#RRGGBB) for ecoregion cartographic display.

table:columns.name: COLOR_BIO
table:columns.description: Hex color string (#RRGGBB) for biome-level cartographic display.

table:columns.name: COLOR_NNH
table:columns.description: Hex color string (#RRGGBB) for Nature Needs Half cartographic display.

table:columns.name: LICENSE
table:columns.description: License string. Always 'CC-BY 4.0'.

table:columns.name: SHAPE_Length
table:columns.description: Perimeter length (duplicate of SHAPE_LENG from GDB conversion).

table:columns.name: SHAPE_Area
table:columns.description: Area in original CRS units (degrees²). Use geometry for accurate area calculations in projected CRS.

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: double, ymin: double, xmax: double, ymax: double>
table:columns.description: Bounding box of the ecoregion polygon in EPSG:4326.

table:columns.name: SHAPE
table:columns.description: Ecoregion geometry (WGS84 / OGC:CRS84); MULTIPOLYGON.

ecoregion-pmtiles.title: PMTiles for web mapping
ecoregion-pmtiles.description: Pyramid of map tiles for efficient web map rendering.

ecoregion-hex.title: H3 hex-indexed parquet files (resolution 8)
ecoregion-hex.description: H3 hexed representation (native resolution 8; parent resolution 0). One hex row = one (ecoregion, H3 cell) pair, so every attribute column is the per-ecoregion value repeated on each cell the ecoregion covers. Never SUM a per-ecoregion total across hex rows (e.g. SHAPE_Area, SHAPE_Length, SHAPE_LENG); dedup by _cng_fid first (SELECT DISTINCT _cng_fid, col). Ecoregion count = COUNT(DISTINCT _cng_fid). For area from the H3 footprint see the h3-guide.
